macroStories.title: Purpose, Reconsidered
macroStories.subtitle: Familiar utility. Softer structure. A cleaner everyday wardrobe.
macroStories.introduction: The next chapter of utility feels more considered: a better-placed pocket, a softer shoulder, a trouser with a clearer line. These are recognisable pieces with a fresh point of view.

macroStories.title: Texture, With Character
macroStories.subtitle: Depth, softened colour and a trace of craft.
macroStories.introduction: A brushed surface, a blurred check, a quiet herringbone. Texture gives everyday clothes a more personal feel, balanced by simple shapes and an easy way of dressing.

stories.title: Utility, Rebalanced
stories.subtitle: Workwear roots meet a softer line and details with purpose.
takeaways: Keep the familiar chore silhouette; bring a little more ease to the sleeve and body.
Let a closing collar and thoughtfully placed pockets carry the update.
Pair a textured outer layer with a smooth shirt or fine knit beneath.

materialRoutes.name: Washed canvas
materialRoutes.description: A gently faded face for an understated workwear mood.

materialRoutes.name: Peached twill
materialRoutes.description: A smoother, softer surface for a cleaner jacket line.

materialRoutes.name: Supple ripstop
materialRoutes.description: A fine grid for a lighter, more fluid utility layer.

stories.patternEdit: Let plains lead. Bring in a fading check or irregular tonal mark on one surface, keeping the collar and pockets quiet.
stories.whyRelevant: A natural progression from familiar barn jackets and overshirts, with everyday pockets, easy layers and a recognisable shape.
stories.imageAlt: Navy blouson with a closeable collar and relaxed everyday layers
stories.caption: A closeable collar and an easy jacket line; a separate denim overshirt reference explores workwear pockets.
stories.secondaryCaption: Denim overshirt: a pocket and collar study.

stories.title: The New Top-Layer Shirt
stories.subtitle: A longer line, a considered neckline and room to layer.
takeaways: Extend the hem for an easy open layer or a softly shaped waist.
Explore an open collar that rises into a gentle stand.
Keep the front clean; let a back pleat or a longer cuff define the shape.

materialRoutes.name: Matte poplin
materialRoutes.description: A clean, crisp surface that emphasises the collar and hem.

materialRoutes.name: Stripe Oxford
materialRoutes.description: A familiar woven texture with a fine, composed stripe.

materialRoutes.name: Soft check flannel
materialRoutes.description: A lightly brushed surface with a blurred countryside check.

stories.patternEdit: Choose a fine stripe or softened check with space to breathe. Use a plain collar and clean fastenings to keep the silhouette in focus.
stories.whyRelevant: An easy bridge between the everyday button-front shirt and the familiar overshirt, worn alone or over a simple base layer.
stories.imageAlt: Blue striped shirt illustrating a relaxed body and longer shirt line
stories.caption: A longer striped shirt and a clean poplin reference establish the starting point. The raised neckline is a proposed development.
stories.secondaryCaption: Poplin shirt back: clean seam shaping.

stories.title: A Straighter Direction
stories.subtitle: Relaxed through the leg, defined at the waist.
takeaways: Allow ease through the thigh while keeping a clear vertical line.
Choose a flat front or a single considered pleat rather than excess volume.
Complete the shape with a neat waistband and straightforward pockets.

materialRoutes.name: Compact cotton twill
materialRoutes.description: A defined weave for a clean, familiar trouser line.

materialRoutes.name: Soft-drape twill
materialRoutes.description: A more fluid expression of the same relaxed straight leg.

materialRoutes.name: Fine textured suiting
materialRoutes.description: A quiet woven surface for a more polished everyday option.

stories.patternEdit: Keep the outline clear with plains and near-plains. A discreet micro check adds depth without changing the easy character.
stories.whyRelevant: An approachable extension of chinos and relaxed trousers, paired just as easily with an overshirt as with a cleaner everyday shirt.
stories.imageAlt: Straight-leg corduroy trousers showing a clear line from hip to hem
stories.caption: Men’s and women’s straight-leg references. Compare the leg balance before moving into the proposed cloth alternatives.
stories.secondaryCaption: A women’s straight leg provides a second fit reference.

stories.title: The Tactile Everyday Coat
stories.subtitle: Soft volume and quiet contrast bring a new character to a familiar layer.
takeaways: Let a softly rounded body or relaxed shoulder refresh the familiar coat.
Balance the surface with a simple fastening and generous, clean-lined pockets.
Keep contrast close in colour, using a collar or facing for a quieter change.

materialRoutes.name: Brushed coating
materialRoutes.description: A soft, matte face with a gentle sense of depth.

materialRoutes.name: Quiet herringbone
materialRoutes.description: A familiar directional weave in a restrained tonal pairing.

materialRoutes.name: Soft boucle
materialRoutes.description: A small looped surface, balanced by an uncomplicated shape.

stories.patternEdit: Build interest through the weave. Melange, a fine herringbone or a low-contrast check keeps the coat easy to combine.
stories.whyRelevant: A considered everyday layer that sits comfortably beside casual jackets, while offering a more polished way to finish the wardrobe.
stories.imageAlt: Brown shawl-collar coat illustrating soft structure and tactile layering
stories.caption: Soft coating and a checked coat reference show two ways to give a familiar layer more character.
stories.secondaryCaption: A checked coat: pattern carried by the cloth.

stories.title: The Softer Button-Up
stories.subtitle: Familiar shirting, refreshed through drape, weave and a quieter pattern.
takeaways: Keep an easy button-front shape that works open or neatly tucked.
Choose a softened check or tonal weave instead of a louder all-over statement.
Use well-aligned pockets and restrained buttons to sharpen the finish.

materialRoutes.name: Brushed check flannel
materialRoutes.description: A blurred plaid with a gentle transition between colours.

materialRoutes.name: Tonal herringbone flannel
materialRoutes.description: A quieter woven rhythm with a softly brushed face.

materialRoutes.name: Fine cotton dobby
materialRoutes.description: A small geometric texture for a cleaner interpretation.

stories.patternEdit: Keep one pattern in focus. A softened plaid, fine herringbone or small woven geometry brings depth without crowding the outfit.
stories.whyRelevant: A recognisable flannel and button-up wardrobe, refreshed through pattern balance, surface and the finishing details that make a simple shirt feel considered.
stories.imageAlt: Brown button-front shirt illustrating drape and a simple everyday shape
stories.caption: A draped button-up is the silhouette reference. Brushed checks, herringbone and dobby below are proposed alternative fabric routes.
stories.secondaryCaption: A relaxed back line and the fall of the cloth.

stories.title: Texture in Motion
stories.subtitle: Corduroy, soft twill and quiet checks bring depth to a relaxed leg.
takeaways: Explore a gentle curve through the leg, finishing with a composed hem opening.
Let the cloth define the shape: a clear wale, a softer drape or a fine woven check.
Balance the fuller line with a simple shirt and a shorter outer layer.

materialRoutes.name: Soft corduroy
materialRoutes.description: A defined wale that gives a familiar trouser a richer surface.

materialRoutes.name: Fluid twill
materialRoutes.description: A smooth, falling line for a softer interpretation of volume.

materialRoutes.name: Subtle check cloth
materialRoutes.description: A small, close-toned check with a more tailored character.

stories.patternEdit: Let wale and weave carry the interest. Keep checks close in tone, pairing them with an uncomplicated upper half.
stories.whyRelevant: Adds a fresh leg balance to familiar comfort-led trousers, with texture giving the wearer another choice beyond a plain chino or an existing wide leg.
stories.imageAlt: Brown pleated barrel-leg trousers with controlled volume and a composed hem
stories.caption: A gentle barrel silhouette and a corduroy garment detail. The alternative cloth routes are development options.
stories.secondaryCaption: Corduroy garment detail: wale and surface character.
